title: can you check my logs from last night and tell if the commander was moa'd? signet of moa incoming

turns.userText: can you check my logs from last night and tell if the commander was moa'd? signet of moa incoming
turns.agentText:
I'll find last night's fights and check whether the commander got hit by Signet of Moa.

Found 13 fights from last night (Nov 14, 18:03–19:27). Let me pull the overviews to find the commander and check coverage for buff/transform data.

Both big fights have boon/squad_buff and replay data present, but `conditions` is `not_computed`. Moa Morph (the Signet of Moa transform) is tracked as an effect/buff, so let me find the commander entity and search the buff catalog for Moa. Let me inspect the raw doc.

The transform buff is id **10179 "Morphed (Polymorph Moa)"**. Note there's no commander flag in the raw entities, so let me (a) find who actually got that buff, and (b) pin down who the commander was. Let me check the buff across the squad and inspect the participant structure.

No commander flag exists in raw logs (`combat_participant` is just a true/false participation bool). The transform buff lives under `squad_buffs`. Let me find who received buff 10179, and separately identify the commander via commander stats.

Entity id "1" got Moa Morph in the big fight. The main tag is **harasho.4281 (Sentinel Harasho)** — 49 runs/859 fights led, by far the primary commander; Jordan.1860 (Mesmer Kamoidra) is the #2 tag. Let me map the moa'd entity to a name and sweep all 13 logs for the transform.

Confirmed — the Moa Morph (Signet of Moa) landed in two fights last night, and **both times on Mesmer Kamoidra (Jordan.1860)**, not on the main tag. Let me grab the second fight's duration so I can give the transform time in seconds.

The moa didn't land on the main tag — it hit the squad's #2 commander, Mesmer Kamoidra, twice.

**Who got moa'd:** Across all 13 fights last night (18:03–19:27), the Signet of Moa transform (buff *Morphed (Polymorph Moa)*, id 10179) landed on only one person — **Mesmer Kamoidra (Jordan.1860)**, and it happened in the last two fights of the night:

| Fight | Time | Transform uptime | ≈ time as a moa |
|---|---|---|---|
| 13c27da8 | 19:14 | 0.21% | ~2s |
| c27f67bd | 19:27 | 1.29% | ~6s |

Both times Jordan was sitting in subgroup 2 — the same party as the main tag.

**On "the commander":** Your primary tag is **Sentinel Harasho (harasho.4281)**, by far the most-used commander (49 runs / 859 fights led), and he was running Spellbreaker last night. He was **not** moa'd in any of the 13 fights. The player who ate the moa, Jordan.1860, is your #2 commander (33 runs / 672 fights led) and was in the tag's group.

So:
- If you mean Harasho/the pin → **no, never transformed**.
- If you mean Jordan (co-commander/the squad mesmer) → **yes, twice**, but both were short-lived (~2s and ~6s), so he was cleansed/stunbroken out quickly rather than caught out for a full 10s.

A couple of caveats worth stating: these logs have `conditions` as `not_computed`, but the moa transform is tracked as a squad buff (which **is** present here), so the detection is solid. The second-to-second timing is derived from uptime %, so the "~2s / ~6s" figures are approximate.

Want me to pull the exact timestamp of each moa cast and what happened to Jordan right after (downed? survived?) in those two fights?
